grammar.title: Expressing Pain and Symptoms with 'Doler' and 'Tener'
grammar.explanation:
Spanish has specific structures for describing symptoms:

1. Doler (to hurt) - works like 'gustar':
• Me duele la cabeza. - My head hurts. (lit. The head hurts to me.)
• Me duelen los pies. - My feet hurt.
• ¿Te duele algo? - Does something hurt?

2. Tener + symptom noun:
• Tener fiebre - to have a fever
• Tener tos - to have a cough
• Tener dolor de... - to have a ... ache
• Tener gripe - to have the flu

3. Sentirse (to feel) + adjective:
• Me siento mal/bien. - I feel bad/good.
• Se siente mareado. - He feels dizzy.
